title: Sampled Fourier polynomial
statement: Given $s\in\mathbb N$, a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and samples $S_i\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ for $i=1,\ldots,s$, define the sampled Fourier polynomial to be the sparse Fourier approximation associated with the family of sampled subsets and their sampled coefficients.
